title: High-resolution evapotranspiration dataset for the Aconcagua River Basin (SAFER / Landsat / ERA5-Land)
description:
Automated, cloud-based framework implemented in Google Earth Engine to estimate actual evapotranspiration (ETa) at 30 m spatial resolution over the Aconcagua River Basin, Chile.

The workflow applies the SAFER (Simple Algorithm for Evapotranspiration Retrieving) algorithm with fixed, historically calibrated coefficients (a = 0.3684, b = -0.0012, derived from a 10-year analysis, 2014-2024) to Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 Level-2 surface reflectance and surface temperature, combined with daily reference evapotranspiration (ET0, FAO-56 Penman-Monteith) computed from ERA5-Land reanalysis. A monthly-median gap-filling strategy preserves temporal continuity in cloud-affected periods. Outputs are daily, monthly and annual ETa rasters (mm) at 30 m.

This repository contains the source code supporting the article "An operational satellite-based framework for high-resolution evapotranspiration monitoring in data-scarce Mediterranean basins".
